meaning.hi: प्राण उसकी और सिर के सिरे की रखवाली करता है, मन भी

meaning.en: the heavens are not protected by the host of gods
meaning.hi: स्वर्ग देवताओं के समूह से रक्षित नहीं

words.sanskrit: na cha antarikshani na cha bhumah imah

meaning.en: nor the spaces of the mid-air, nor these earths
meaning.hi: न अंतरिक्ष, न ये पृथ्वियाँ

meaning.en: that in which this whole world is woven through and threaded together
meaning.hi: जिसमें यह पूरा जगत आड़े-सीधे बुना है

words.sanskrit: tasmat anyat na param kinchana asti

meaning.en: beyond that, there is nothing else at all
meaning.hi: उसके परे और कुछ नहीं है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: na tasmat purvam na param tat asti

meaning.en: there is nothing before it and nothing after it
meaning.hi: उससे पहले कुछ नहीं और बाद में कुछ नहीं

words.sanskrit: na bhutam na uta bhavyam yat asit

meaning.en: nothing that has been, nothing to come that ever existed
meaning.hi: न हो चुका, न होनेवाला जो कभी रहा हो

meaning.en: thousand-footed, spread out with a single head
meaning.hi: हज़ार पैरों वाला, एक सिर से फैला हुआ

meaning.en: it is this very one who keeps turning about as all that has come to be
meaning.hi: वही इस सारे हो चुके के रूप में घूमता है

meaning.en: out of the imperishable syllable, time is born
meaning.hi: अक्षर से काल जन्मता है

meaning.en: and out of time, he is called the one who spreads
meaning.hi: काल से वह व्यापक कहा जाता है

meaning.en: for it is Rudra the lord who is the one who spreads, resting to take pleasure
meaning.hi: व्यापक रुद्र ही है, सुख लेने को

words.sanskrit: yada shete rudrah tada samharyate prajah

meaning.en: when Rudra lies down, then the creatures are gathered in
meaning.hi: जब रुद्र लेटता है, तब प्रजा समेटी जाती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: when he breathes out, darkness comes to be
meaning.hi: जब वह साँस बाहर छोड़ता है, अँधेरा हो जाता है

meaning.en: out of darkness the waters; stirred with a finger
meaning.hi: अँधेरे से जल; उँगली से मथा जाता है

words.sanskrit: mathitam shishire shishiram mathyamanam phenam bhavati

meaning.en: what is stirred is in the cold; stirred further, it becomes foam
meaning.hi: मथा हुआ ठंड में है; और मथने पर झाग बनता है

words.sanskrit: phenat andam bhavati andat brahma bhavati

meaning.en: out of foam an egg, out of the egg Brahma
meaning.hi: झाग से अंडा, अंडे से ब्रह्मा

meaning.en: out of Brahma, wind; out of wind, Om
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा से वायु; वायु से ओंकार

words.sanskrit: omkarat savitri savitrya gayatri gayatrya lokah bhavanti

meaning.en: out of Om the Savitri, from Savitri the Gayatri, from Gayatri the worlds
meaning.hi: ॐ से सावित्री, सावित्री से गायत्री, गायत्री से लोक

words.sanskrit: archayanti tapah satyam madhu ksharanti yat bhuvam

meaning.en: people honour heat and truth, letting the earth's own honey run down
meaning.hi: लोग तप और सत्य का मान करते हैं, पृथ्वी का मधु बहने देते हैं

meaning.en: this is the highest form of heat
meaning.hi: यही सबसे ऊँचा तप है

words.sanskrit: apah jyotih rasah amritam brahma bhur-bhuvah svah namah iti

meaning.en: waters, light, sap, deathless, brahman — earth, mid-world, heaven — a bow
meaning.hi: जल, ज्योति, रस, अमृत, ब्रह्म — भूः भुवः स्वः — नमन

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the brahmin who studies this Atharvasiras all the way through
meaning.hi: जो ब्राह्मण इस अथर्वशिर का अध्ययन करता है

meaning.en: if unlearned in recitation, comes to have learned it
meaning.hi: अनपढ़ हो तो पढ़ा हुआ हो जाता है

meaning.en: if ungiven the sacred thread, comes to have been given it
meaning.hi: जनेऊ न मिला हो तो मिला हुआ हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: sah agni-putah bhavati sah vayu-putah bhavati sah surya-putah bhavati

meaning.en: he comes to be purified by fire, by wind, by the sun
meaning.hi: वह अग्नि, वायु, सूर्य से पवित्र हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: sah sarvaih devaih jnatah bhavati sah sarvaih vedaih anudhyatah bhavati

meaning.en: he comes to be known by all the gods, thought upon by all the Vedas
meaning.hi: वह सारे देवताओं का जाना और वेदों का ध्याया हो जाता है

meaning.en: he comes to have bathed at every sacred ford
meaning.hi: वह हर तीर्थ में नहाया हुआ हो जाता है

meaning.en: through this, he comes to have performed every ritual sacrifice
meaning.hi: इससे वह हर यज्ञ किया हुआ हो जाता है

meaning.en: sixty thousand mutterings of the Gayatri come to have been muttered
meaning.hi: गायत्री के साठ हज़ार जप जपे हुए हो जाते हैं

meaning.en: a hundred thousand mutterings of the epics, old books and Rudra-hymns come to have been muttered
meaning.hi: इतिहास-पुराणों और रुद्र-मंत्रों के एक लाख जप जपे हुए हो जाते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: ten thousand mutterings of the pranava come to have been muttered
meaning.hi: प्रणव के दस हज़ार जप जपे हुए हो जाते हैं

meaning.en: he purifies the line his eye falls upon
meaning.hi: वह अपनी नज़र पड़नेवाली पंक्ति को पवित्र करता है

words.sanskrit: a saptamat purusha-yugan punati iti aha bhagavan atharva-shirah

meaning.en: he purifies back to seven generations — so says the lord Atharvasiras
meaning.hi: वह सात पीढ़ी पीछे तक पवित्र करता है — ऐसा अथर्वशिर कहते हैं

words.sanskrit: sakrit japtva eva shuchih sah putah karmanyah bhavati

meaning.en: having muttered it once, a person becomes clean, purified, fit for sacred work
meaning.hi: एक बार जपने पर आदमी शुद्ध, पवित्र, कार्य-योग्य हो जाता है

meaning.en: muttering it a second time, he attains headship over the hosts
meaning.hi: दूसरी बार जपने पर गणों की अधिपति मिलती है

meaning.en: muttering it a third time, he goes right into that reality, just so
meaning.hi: तीसरी बार जपने पर वह उसी में प्रवेश कर जाता है

words.sanskrit: om satyam om satyam om satyam

meaning.en: Om, that is true. Om, that is true. Om, that is true
meaning.hi: ॐ सत्यम्, ॐ सत्यम्, ॐ सत्यम्

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
